battle.name: 陳濤斜之戰
battle.brief: 至德元年（756）春，叛軍已陷洛陽，為接通糧道、把豫西山道攥在手中，兵鋒再向汝州、襄城推進；唐軍在洛陽西南的陳陶斜憑險拒守，以弩陣封住狹窄谷道，與攻方在坡上坡下往來攻守數日，終以隘口不失、叛軍退去收場。卡面羅馬弩砲不屬本役，它早於此役約八百年，卻點出同一道理：單發重箭的機弩，威力全在那一瞬的封鎖。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰一方是唐王朝的平叛軍隊，另一方是安史叛軍在河南方向的部隊。叛方名義上仍奉安祿山之子安慶緒為主，實際在中原行動的是安祿山死後接掌河北兵權的史思明，以及尹子奇、令狐潮、安守忠等部將所領的河北、山西兵與裹挾來的胡騎；朝廷一方則是唐軍在河南各道的官軍與募兵，隸屬於魯靈、陳爾、張巡、許遠等將領的部曲，兵源雜，既有朔方、關中、隴右調來的蕃漢兵，也有河南本地臨時募集的團練。陳陶斜在編制上屬河南道汝州轄境，是唐廷在東都失守後仍想守住的一條西路。此役的具體隸屬與番次，傳世記載極為簡略，只能確定它是至德元年平叛諸役中列在雍丘、寧陵、嘉山、南陽之間的一次交鋒，雙方都沒有留下可核對的指揮記錄。叛軍在河南的部隊多由河北、山西兩道州縣徵發的兵與降附胡騎混編，攻城靠雲梯、撞車與壕塹；唐軍在河南道的守軍則依托城鎮、驛道與屯田據點布防，兩者在這一條山道上的接觸往往不是大隊會戰，而是前哨、游騎與別動隊的試探與反試探。
countriesEn: One side was the Tang court's counter-rebellion army; the other was the rebel force operating in Henan. On the rebel side the fiction of allegiance to An Qingxu, the son of An Lushan, was still maintained, while the troops actually operating in the Central Plain had passed to Shi Siming, who took over the rebel armies in Hebei after An Lushan died, together with commanders such as Yin Ziqi, Linghu Chao and An Shouzhong, drawing on soldiers and horses from Hebei and Shanxi together with the non-Han cavalry they had gathered. On the Tang side stood the regulars and recruited levies of the various Henan circuits, formed into units under commanders such as Lu Ling, Chen Er, Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan, with a mixed personnel base: Tang, Xianzhong and Longyou troops transferred down from the north, frontier soldiers of non-Han origin, and militia hastily raised inside Henan itself. Administratively, Chentao Xie lay within Ruzhou prefecture of Henan circuit, and it was one of the western roads the court still hoped to hold after losing the eastern capital. The affiliation of this engagement and the units involved in it are recorded very thinly: all that can be established is that it belongs to the set of counter-rebellion actions fought in 756, listed alongside the fighting at Yongqiu, Ningling, Jiashan and Nanyang, and that neither side left a command record that can be checked against anything else. The rebel troops in Henan were mixed columns of men levied in the circuits of Hebei and Shanxi together with surrendered non-Han cavalry, and they assaulted with scaling ladders, battering rams and trenches; the Tang forces in Henan circuit, by contrast, took their stand from towns, post stations and garrison-farm depots. What met on this mountain road was therefore seldom a set-piece battle of large bodies, but the testing and counter-testing of outposts, patrols and detached columns.
people: 本役的直接指揮者，現存史料沒有留下名字。可確定的背景人物，是唐軍在河南戰線上的幾位主角：張巡、許遠與南霽雲自雍丘、寧陵一線轉戰睢陽，屢挫尹子奇部；魯炅以陳留、濮州兵守陳留；李光弼、郭子儀在河北與河東一線對史思明作戰；而在關中，哥舒翰於同年冬在靈寶外被叛軍突破，潼關失守，長安淪陷，肅宗李亨出奔靈武。陳陶斜之戰正落在這條震動線的北段：叛軍自河北南下、洛陽到手之後，必須打通通往汝州、襄城的通道，才能把糧道與後方接到洛陽；唐廷則明白，一旦陳陶斜這類隘口失守，叛軍就能直接威脅東都以南的漕運與江南轉運。編纂歷代戰役的辭書收錄此役時只留下地名、時間與勝負大意，雙方名將均未具名，這既是史實本身，也是本卡必須如實交代的空白。史思明在河北接掌兵權之後，重點是重新打通河北與中原的聯繫；安慶緒坐鎮洛陽，倚重尹子奇、令狐潮等原河南道的降將與胡將。同一條線上，肅宗在靈武即位後起用郭子儀、李光弼等一批平叛名將，把重心由關中轉回河南與河北，這是理解陳陶斜一役為何被列在至德元年諸役之中的關鍵。
peopleEn: The commanders of this engagement are not named in any surviving record. What can be established are the background figures of the Tang war effort in Henan: Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan and Nan Jiyun moved from the Yongqiu and Ningling fronts towards Suiyang and repeatedly checked Yin Ziqi's troops; Lu Ling held Chenliu with troops from Chenliu and Puyang; Li Guangbi and Guo Ziyi fought Shi Siming in Hebei and in the Hedong region. In the west, in the same year, Geshu Han was broken by the rebels outside Lingbao in winter, the pass at Tong was lost, Chang'an fell, and Emperor Suzong Li Heng fled to Lingwu. The battle of Chentao Xie sits on the northern stretch of that same line of shock: once the rebels had marched down from Hebei and taken Luoyang, they had to open the road towards Ruzhou and Xiangcheng in order to connect their supply line to their rear; and the court understood that if a position such as Chentao Xie were lost, the rebels would stand directly over the canal transport south of the eastern capital and over the grain traffic from Jiangnan. When the dictionaries of historical campaigns took this engagement into their lists, they preserved the place name, the date and the rough outcome, but not a single named commander on either side. That is the state of the record itself, and it is the gap this card has to state plainly. After taking over the rebel armies in Hebei, Shi Siming's priority was to reopen the link between Hebei and the Central Plain; An Qingxu sat at Luoyang and relied on former officers of Henan circuit such as Yin Ziqi and Linghu Chao, together with his non-Han commanders. On the same line, once the Suzong emperor had taken his throne at Lingwu he put men like Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi in the field and moved the weight of the war effort out of Guanzhong and back towards Henan and Hebei, and that is the key to understanding why an engagement at Chentao Xie is counted among the actions of 756.
kits: 本役的兵器，就是唐軍在山道隘口最倚重的弩。守方在坡頂居高臨下，以單兵張弩與床弩夾射坡下窄道，箭矢仰射，前排持盾遮蔽，後排以長槊封住缺口；唐代弩的形制從單兵手張的小弩，到張力數石的床弩、擘張弩與竹木為臂的攻城大弩都有，與卡面這件羅馬弩砲在原理上相通：扭力儲能、單發重箭、一次一矢，瞄準靠標尺而不是靠臂力，射擊節奏慢而單發，每一箭都靠命中而不是靠覆蓋。卡面的羅馬弩砲約公元前五十年出現，是羅馬軍團用來對付密集步兵陣與城牆的機弩，技術來源是公元前四世紀馬其頓人改良的扭力投射器；它早於本役約八百年，沒有任何證據顯示它出現在過中國的戰場。兩者真正共通的，是「以單發重火力封鎖一個點」的思路：陳陶斜的斜谷寬度有限，弩的射程與穿透力因此能發揮到極致；可一旦對手貼上城牆或攀入坡頂的死角，弩便無用武之地，這正是本役勝負轉折之處。唐代弩的維修與備件也相對簡便：弩臂、弦與機牙可以在軍中自備，箭則大量取自地方武庫，這也是它比早期希臘扭力砲更容易在長時間圍城與隘口防守中維持的原因。
kitsEn: The weapons that mattered in this engagement were the crossbows on which the Tang defence of a mountain road relied. The defenders, holding the top of the slope, shot down the narrow way below with single-hand bows and with mounted bed crossbows, arrows fired upward on a high arc, the front rank covered by shields and the rear rank sealing the gaps with long spears. Tang crossbows ranged from light bows drawn by one man to bed crossbows, powerful traction bows and great bamboo-and-timber siege engines throwing many tens of stones; in principle they answer to the same logic as the Roman piece on the card: torsion-stored energy, a single heavy bolt per shot, one shot at a time, sighting laid on a mark rather than on muscle, a slow rhythm and exact aiming, every shot counting because it hit rather than because it covered an area. The Roman scorpio on the card appeared around 50 BC, as a bolt-throwing engine of the Roman legions used against dense infantry formations and city walls, its technique inherited from the torsion catapults the Macedonians improved in the fourth century BC. It precedes this engagement by about eight hundred years, and no evidence places it on any Chinese battlefield. What the two genuinely share is the idea of sealing one point with single-shot heavy force: the width of the sloping valley at Chentao Xie was narrow, so the reach and penetration of the crossbow could be pushed to their limit; yet once an opponent closed against the wall or scrambled into the blind ground at the top of the slope, the crossbow was good for nothing, and that is precisely where this engagement turned. Maintenance and spares for Tang crossbows were also comparatively simple: the bow stave, the string and the trigger could be made or repaired within the army, while the bolts were drawn in bulk from the local arsenals, which is one reason the weapon held up far better over long sieges and long pass defences than the earlier Greek torsion engines had done.
tactics: 本役的戰法，現存材料只能由地形與同期戰例推知。陳陶斜之名即取「斜」字，指的是一道夾在崗嶺之間、坡度向一側傾斜的谷道；這類地形兩側是便於設伏的高地，中間路徑狹窄，車馬難成橫陣，攻方只能以單列或小隊縱隊前進，守方則以縱深配置把弩手分置前後。合理的部署是：第一線在坡口以盾兵、鎗手封住路幅，逼使攻方減速並暴露隊形；第二線在坡腰的床弩位上以單發重箭打擊攻隊的先鋒與旗手；第三線留預備隊與短兵，在攻方被釘在坡下時以長槊與陌刀出擊封口。進攻方若強攻，則以單盾推進、輕裝先鋒乘隙攀坡，並用弓弩對射掩護梯隊；若久攻不下，則可能改走迂迴，或轉向其他隘口。補給方面，唐軍據汝州、襄城一線的城鎮取糧，以驛道與人力車隊往隘口輸送；叛軍若自洛陽方向來，糧道反而是它更脆弱的一環，這正是本役在守方頂住之後仍能續撐的原因之一。
tacticsEn: The method of fighting in this engagement can only be reconstructed from the terrain and from comparable actions of the same years. The name Chentao Xie takes its character from the word xie, a slope: a valley road pinched between ridges whose grade falls away to one side. On such ground the high ground on both flanks invites ambush, the path in the middle is narrow, carts and horses cannot be deployed in line, and an attacker can only advance in single file or in small columns, while the defender distributes its crossbowmen in depth along the slope. A sensible deployment would put the first line at the mouth of the slope, with shield-bearers and spearmen closing the width of the road so as to slow the attack and expose its formation; a second line on the middle slope, with bed crossbows, putting single heavy bolts into the vanguard and the standard-bearers of the attacking column; and a third line of reserves and close infantry, ready to strike down the gap with long spears and the modao sabre once the attackers were pinned on the lower slope. An assaulting force that meant to force the position would advance behind single shields, send lightly equipped men up the slope wherever a gap opened, and cover the echelons with reciprocal archery; failing that, it might have tried a wide flanking movement or shifted to another pass. On the supply side the Tang drew grain from the towns strung along Ruzhou and Xiangcheng and sent it to the pass by post road and by human cart transport, while a rebel army advancing from Luoyang found its own grain line the more fragile of the two, which is one reason why the defence could hold and then hold on.
data: 可以核實的數字非常有限，這正是本役史料薄弱的直接反映。時間上：至德元年（756）春，河南平叛各役在雍丘、寧陵、嘉山、南陽一線同時進行，陳陶斜之戰即其中之一；同年六月唐軍在潼關外靈寶失利、七月長安淪陷、十月肅宗抵達靈武，可作本役的時序座標。距離上：陳陶斜距洛陽約一百餘里，至汝州、襄城各有數十里至百餘里，是東都西南方向最短的山道之一，這條距離正是它必須被守住的價值所在。兵力、斬獲與損耗三者都沒有留下可核對的數目，只能從編制上推知：兩邊都要能同時拉出多個營的兵，否則無法在狹窄谷道中形成攻守；本役的成敗也不能用殲滅戰解釋，多半是一場把進攻方擋在隘口之外的阻斷戰，而不是會戰。糧秣方面，汝州是河南道軍糧轉運的節點之一，倉儲、驛傳與役畜的供應，決定了守軍能撐多少天。
dataEn: The figures that can be verified are very few, and that thinness is itself the direct reflection of how poorly the engagement was recorded. On timing: in the spring of 756, the counter-rebellion actions in Henan were being fought simultaneously along the Yongqiu, Ningling, Jiashan and Nanyang fronts, and the battle of Chentao Xie was one of them; the Tang defeat outside Lingbao at the Tong pass in the sixth month, the fall of Chang'an in the seventh, and the arrival of the Suzong emperor at Lingwu in the tenth can serve as chronological coordinates for it. On distance: Chentao Xie lay a little over one hundred li from Luoyang and from fifty-odd to a hundred-odd li from Ruzhou and Xiangcheng, making it one of the shortest roads southwest of the eastern capital, and that distance is precisely what made the position worth holding. Troop strengths, kills and losses leave no figures that can be checked; one can only infer from the structure of the armies that both sides were able to commit several units at once, since no other arrangement could have produced an attack and a defence inside a narrow valley. The outcome cannot be read as an annihilation battle either: it was, in all likelihood, a blocking action that kept the attacker outside the pass rather than a set-piece engagement. As for supply, Ruzhou was one of the nodes through which military grain moved in Henan circuit, and the grain stores, post service and draft animals available there determined how many days the garrison could hold out.
cause: 直接原因在安史之亂的大勢：755 年安祿山自范陽起兵南下，河北諸州望風披靡，至德元年（756）正月已下河北、陷洛陽，懷州、洛陽之後，叛軍的補給線被拉長到極限，急需打通山道、控制豫西的糧倉與城鎮，陳陶斜因此成為必爭之地。深層原因是唐朝的結構性弱點：開元、天寶年間府兵制崩壞，募兵長期駐北不改調，邊鎮節度使坐大到反客為主，兵精糧足卻無制約的部署機制；河南道是漕運與轉運的咽喉，一旦洛陽落入叛軍，江南的粟米、鹽與布帛要轉運至西北軍隊與京師，就只能繞道或改走陸路，朝廷的財政與軍需立刻吃緊。於是守住豫西山道，不只是守住一座隘口，而是守住東都以南的物流命脈；這也是唐廷在潼關連失之後，仍要在河南各隘口分兵死守的原因。
causeEn: The immediate cause lies in the shape of the An Lushan rebellion. In 755 An Lushan rose in Fan Yang and marched south, and the provinces of Hebei collapsed before him; by the first month of 756 the rebels had taken Hebei and Luoyang, and after the fall of Huai prefecture and of the eastern capital their supply line was stretched to breaking point. They needed urgently to open the mountain roads, to control the granaries and towns of western Henan, and Chentao Xie therefore became a position that had to be taken. The deeper cause lies in the structural weaknesses of the Tang: through the Kaiyuan and Tianbao reigns the fubing militia system fell apart, recruited troops stayed in the north without being rotated home, and the jiedushi of the frontier commands grew so powerful that the court's own arrangements turned inside out, giving the empire excellent soldiers and ample grain but no mechanism able to constrain or redeploy them. Henan circuit was the throat of the canal and of the grain traffic, and once Luoyang was in rebel hands, the millet, salt and cloth of Jiangnan bound for the northwestern armies and for the capital had to travel by a longer road or overland, and the court's finances and supply system were immediately strained. Holding the passes of western Henan was therefore not about holding one gap in a mountain range; it was about holding the artery of movement south of the eastern capital. That is why the court continued to split its forces and hold the Henan passes even after the loss of the pass at Tong.
impact: 陳陶斜之戰的直接影響，是叛軍打通豫西、抓住洛陽西南通道的企圖在這一段被拖住；同時，唐軍在河南以小股兵力扼守隘口、拖慢叛軍的做法，也在此後兩年裡被反覆使用，成為平叛初期唯一可行的戰術：不正面接戰，而是以城、以隘、以道把叛軍的推進速度壓成一段一段的消耗。其長期影響則更沉重：至德元年以來的混戰最終以兩京陷落、兩京光復、史朝義覆亡收場，而整場戰爭留下的兵禍、糧價飛漲與藩鎮割據，成為唐由盛轉衰的分水嶺；陳陶斜這樣的戰役本身無法左右國運，但它所代表的那種「一線城隘、一批弓弩、一支精幹守軍」的抵抗形式，正是唐廷在失去洛陽與關中之後，仍然拖住叛軍兩年的方法。值得留意的是，此役也說明安史之亂的戰事並非只有大城攻防：陳陶斜這類無名隘口上，勝負往往取決於守軍對地形的熟悉、器械的備妥與補給的距離，而不是兵力的多寡；後來平叛各役中，地方團練在缺少朝廷支援的情況下仍能堅守若干城池，這種以地形換時間的做法，正是從這一階段的守隘戰爭裡慢慢形成的。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the battle of Chentao Xie was that the rebels' attempt to open western Henan and seize the road southwest of Luoyang was held up at this point. At the same time, the Tang practice in Henan of blocking passes with small bodies of men and of slowing the rebel advance to a crawl was used repeatedly over the following two years, and became the only workable method available in the early phase of the counter-rebellion: not to accept battle on open ground, but to compress the rebels' rate of advance into a series of short, grinding stages by means of towns, passes and roads. The long-term consequences are heavier still. The convulsion that began in 756 ended with the two capitals falling, the two capitals being retaken, and the extinction of Shi Chaoyi, while the warfare itself left behind desolation, soaring grain prices and the power of the regional commands that marked the turn of the Tang from strength to decline. An engagement such as Chentao Xie could not by itself have changed the course of the empire, but the kind of resistance it represents, a single line of towns and passes, a stock of bows and crossbows and a few picked garrison troops, was precisely the method that allowed the Tang court, after losing Luoyang and the Guanzhong basin, to hold the rebels for two more years. It is worth noticing as well that this engagement shows the war was not only about storming great cities: at obscure passes such as Chentao Xie the outcome turned on the defenders' familiarity with the ground, the state of their engines and the distance their supplies had to travel, rather than on the weight of numbers. Later in the war, locally raised militia held several cities for long stretches without support from the court, and that habit of buying time with terrain grew out of the pass-fighting of this very stage of the conflict.
result: 結果是唐軍守住陳陶斜，叛軍未能由此道深入汝州、襄城，戰役以阻斷戰的方式收束。此後的走向是：同年之內，叛軍主力轉向關中，潼關與長安相繼失守，肅宗出奔靈武，河南一時盡入叛軍之手；次年郭子儀、李光弼在河北反攻，兩京相繼光復，睢陽則以糧盡援絕、守軍全沒收場；安史之亂最終以史朝義在幽州窮蹙自殺而終。至德元年春天的陳陶斜之戰沒有改變戰爭的整體方向，但它是河南平叛諸役中的一環：它證明叛軍並非無往不利，唐軍在沒有援兵、沒有糧草保證的據點上，靠山道與器械仍能擋住進攻，也因此讓朝廷在長安失陷之後保住了江淮的漕運線與豫西的一批可供屯兵的地點。陳陶斜之戰留下的並非一座可以指認的戰場遺址，而是一條仍然可用的山道與一批仍然能徵發的鄉兵；對後世編年者而言，它的意義在於補上了至德元年河南戰線的一段空白。
resultEn: The result was that the Tang held Chentao Xie: the rebels did not force their way through into Ruzhou and Xiangcheng, and the engagement closed as a blocking action. What followed ran as follows. Within the same year the main rebel force turned west toward the Guanzhong basin, the pass at Tong and then Chang'an fell, the Suzong emperor fled to Lingwu, and Henan passed for a time entirely into rebel hands. In the year after, Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi counter-attacked in Hebei, the two capitals were retaken in turn, and Suiyang ended with its defenders dead to the last man after their food and their relief failed. The rebellion as a whole ended with Shi Chaoyi taking his own life when he was cornered at You prefecture. The battle of Chentao Xie in the spring of 756 did not change the general direction of the war, but it was one link in the chain of Henan counter-rebellion actions, and it demonstrated two things: that the rebels were not invincible, and that Tang troops holding a position without reinforcement and without assured supply could still stop an assault by means of the ground and their artillery. It also helped the court preserve, after the loss of Chang'an, the grain route from Jiangnan and a number of sites in western Henan suitable for quartering troops. What the battle of Chentao Xie left behind is not an identifiable battlefield but a road still fit to use and a body of country men still fit to be called up; for the compilers who came after, its value lies in filling a gap in the Henan front of 756.
